question: A right circular cone having height of 30 cm is cut by two parallel planes at heights 10 cm and 20 cm from the base. What is the ratio of the volumes of the three parts (from top to bottom)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The parallel planes are at heights 10 cm and 20 cm from the base, meaning heights from the top are 10 cm and 20 cm.

Heights of the three similar cones from the top vertex are 10 cm, 20 cm, and 30 cm.

Ratio of their heights = 10 : 20 : 30 = 1 : 2 : 3

Since volumes of similar 3D shapes are proportional to the cube of their heights, the ratio of their volumes = 1³ : 2³ : 3³ = 1 : 8 : 27

Ratio of volumes of the individual three parts (top to bottom) = 1 : (8 − 1) : (27 − 8) = 1 : 7 : 19

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 7 : 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total height of the original cone (H) = 30 cm

Cutting planes are parallel to the base at heights 10 cm and 20 cm from the base.

**Formula Used:**

For a right circular cone cut by planes parallel to the base, the smaller cones formed are similar to the original cone.

If two cones are similar with heights h₁ and h₂, the ratio of their volumes is:

⇒ V₁ / V₂ = (h₁ / h₂)³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total height of the cone (H) = 30 cm

⇒ Height of the first cut from base = 20 cm → Height from the top vertex (h₁) = 30 − 20 = 10 cm

⇒ Height of the second cut from base = 10 cm → Height from the top vertex (h₂) = 30 − 10 = 20 cm

⇒ Height of the entire cone (h₃) = 30 cm

Let V₁, V₂, and V₃ be the volumes of the three similar cones starting from the top with heights 10 cm, 20 cm, and 30 cm respectively.

⇒ V₁ : V₂ : V₃ = (10)³ : (20)³ : (30)³

⇒ V₁ : V₂ : V₃ = 1000 : 8000 : 27000

⇒ V₁ : V₂ : V₃ = 1 : 8 : 27

The volumes of the individual parts from top to bottom are:

⇒ Volume of Part 1 (Top cone) = V₁ = 1 part

⇒ Volume of Part 2 (Middle frustum) = V₂ − V₁ = 8 − 1 = 7 parts

⇒ Volume of Part 3 (Bottom frustum) = V₃ − V₂ = 27 − 8 = 19 parts

⇒ Ratio of volumes of the three parts (Top to Bottom) = 1 : 7 : 19

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 7 : 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Similar Solids Property

When a 3D solid is cut parallel to its base to form a smaller similar solid, the ratio of their volumes equals the cube of the ratio of their corresponding linear dimensions (height, radius, or slant height).

Volume of a Cone

The volume of a right circular cone is given by V = (1/3)πr²h, where r is the base radius and h is the perpendicular height.

Volume of a Frustum of a Cone

The volume of a frustum of a cone (the shape remaining after cutting the top off parallel to the base) is V = (1/3)πh(R² + r² + Rr), where h is the frustum's height, and R and r are the radii of its circular bases.
